clean_218.name: HOI-BFM Clean Subset (218 Clips)
clean_218.denominator_note: Strictly filtered from the 847-clip extended pool; all 8 policies passed stand gate on all 218 clips across 6 progressive Sim2Real protocols (strictly isolated by protocol_sha256).
clean_218.sim_config: 1 ms physics dt · engage=reset · data_hoi hand/foot contact labels · hoi-bfm-official-2026-11-23

protocols.label: 1. Nominal Baseline
protocols.desc: Deterministic ideal simulation baseline (zero delay, zero joint damping/friction, nominal object & sensor state).

protocols.label: 2. P0 Real-World Physics
protocols.desc: Deterministic Stage 1 physics alignment: joint damping 0.2, dry friction 0.1, 10 ms control delay, 21-joint back-EMF envelope, ground friction 0.4.

protocols.label: 3. P0 + Input DR
protocols.desc: Stochastic (seed=42 × 2): P0 + joint encoder noise/bias + IMU bias/jitter + camera extrinsics ±2 cm / ±2°.

protocols.label: 4. P0 + Object Physics DR
protocols.desc: Stochastic (seed=42 × 2): P0 + object mass/inertia ×[0.8, 1.2] + sliding friction ×[0.7, 1.3] (≥0.1), nominal initial pose.

protocols.label: 5. P0 + Object Pose DR
protocols.desc: Stochastic (seed=42 × 2): P0 + initial object position Δxy ±1.5 cm & Δyaw ±5°, nominal mass/friction.

protocols.label: 6. Full DR Stress
protocols.desc: Stochastic (seed=42 × 2): P0 + Input DR + Object Physics DR + Object Pose DR combined Sim2Real admission benchmark.
